programs.title: Solar System
programs.desc: The host of the program, Professor Brian Cox, presents selected information about the solar system.Viewers will learn about planets and moons covered with volcanoes that erupt with fire and ice.In the following parts, the scientist talks about the most interesting atmospheric conditions that were noticed on celestial bodies neighboring the Earth.He visits landscapes created by dust whirls, mountains covered with metallic frost and monsoon rains on one of the moons.In addition, Professor Cox will introduce viewers to frozen regions of the solar system, including a dwarf planet with mountains of solid ice floating on it, as well as a black and white moon.

programs.title: Blue Planet 2
programs.desc: For centuries, humanity has believed that the oceans are so vast and their inhabitants are so numerous that human activity cannot harm them.It is now known that this is not true.The existence of many animal species associated with the ocean ecosystem is at risk.This is clearly visible in the example of herring.Overfishing wiped out their population 50 years ago.Currently, thanks to good management, it has been reborn.Human-made noise, industrial pollution and plastic waste also negatively impact ocean life.In turn, more than 2/3 of the world's coral reefs have suffered from global warming.Recent research has revealed that the chemical composition of ocean waters is changing.They become acidic due to carbon dioxide dissolving in them.
